title: Invasion of South Africa
description: Capture the southern African strategic base network.
implementationNotes: Implemented as a standalone two-faction scenario on scenario/britannia-south-africa. Both sides use base faction balance. Britannia starts with no cities, 12 loaded carriers and independent amphibious escorts. Tactical mask uses GSHHG intermediate-resolution 20/80 coastal classification. Campaign registry attaches the exact scenario ID.
